Vendored so the app runs offline and on GitHub Pages without a build step.

| Library | Version | License | Path |
|---|---|---|---|
| three.js | 0.186.1 | MIT | vendor/three |
| occt-import-js (OpenCascade compiled to WebAssembly) | 0.0.23 | LGPL-2.1 | vendor/occt-import-js |
| js-yaml | 5.4.3 | MIT | vendor/js-yaml |

The LGPL library is loaded unmodified as a separate file, so it can be replaced by any compatible build.
